4.0   BUDGET SUMMARY
The Chirundu Town Council Budget stands at K103.9 million, an increase of 23 percent when compared 
to the 2024 budget allocation that stood at K79.7 million. 
The increase is mainly attributed to a 17.7 percent increment in the 2025 Constituency Development 
Fund (CDF) allocation of K36 million, with a K10.2 million provision for Cash For Work (CFW), including a 
10 percent increase in the projected locally mobilised revenue of K34.7 million. 
The Local Authority will also receive a K3.2 million Grant from vehicle licencing, including K8.3 million 
Capital Grant funded by World Bank and K8.4 million as Local Government Equilisation Fund. The budget 
has been allocated to sixteen (16) programmes planned for implementation.
